title.zh: 掩膜与阻挡：开口对了还要挡得住
title.en: Masks and blocking: a correct opening must also block effectively

subtitle.zh: 开口区域 / 阻挡厚度 /边缘展宽/阴影
subtitle.en: Opening / blocking thickness / edge broadening / shadowing

body.zh: 01 定义注入窗口；02 确认材料与厚度
body.en: 01 Define the implant window 02 Confirm material and thickness

body.zh: 03；检查CD与套刻
body.en: 03 Check CD and overlay

body.zh: 04；执行倾斜注入
body.en: 04 Perform tilted implantation

body.zh: 05；剥离光刻胶
body.en: 05 Strip photoresist

body.zh: 06；检查残留与选择区
body.en: 06 Inspect residue and selected regions

body.zh: 核心提示；开放区要注入，保护区要真正挡住
body.en: Key point Implant the open region; truly block the protected region

body.zh: 注入离子束；光刻胶/掩膜；表面膜层；硅片；阻挡区；阻挡区；注入区
body.en: Incident ion beam Photoresist / mask Surface film Silicon wafer Blocked region Blocked region Implanted region

body.zh: 正确阻挡；掩膜有效阻挡，；仅开放区注入
body.en: Correct blocking The mask blocks effectively; implantation is limited to the opening

body.zh: 掩膜穿透；掩膜过薄，离子穿透；造成非选择性注入
body.en: Mask penetration An overly thin mask allows ions through, causing nonselective implantation

body.zh: 横向展宽；边缘横向散射，；导致结向侧向扩展
body.en: Lateral broadening Lateral scattering at edges extends the junction sideways

body.zh: 阴影欠注入；倾斜注入时，；高侧壁背风侧形成阴影
body.en: Shadow-induced under-implantation During tilted implantation, the leeward side of a tall sidewall is shadowed

body.zh: 掩膜阻挡厚度；• 决定阻挡能力；• 过薄可能被穿透；•过厚增加工艺负担
body.en: Mask blocking thickness • Determines blocking capability • Too thin may allow penetration • Too thick adds processing burden

body.zh: 材料密度与组成；• 高密度材料阻挡更强；• 不同材料阻挡能力不同
body.en: Material density and composition • Denser materials block more strongly • Blocking differs between materials

body.zh: 窗口CD与套刻；• 窗口CD决定注入宽度；• 套刻误差影响选择区位置
body.en: Window CD and overlay • Window CD determines implant width • Overlay error shifts the selected region

body.zh: 侧壁高度与注入角度；• 侧壁越高，阴影越明显；• 入射角越大，阴影区；域越大
body.en: Sidewall height and implant angle • Taller sidewalls cast stronger shadows • Larger incidence angles produce larger shadowed regions

body.zh: 增厚掩膜：阻挡能力提高 ↔ 光刻、剥离与阴影负担增加
body.en: Thicker mask: stronger blocking ↔ greater lithography, stripping and shadowing burden

body.zh: 主要风险；掩膜穿透；横向展宽；光刻胶硬化/残留；阴影欠注入
body.en: Main risks Mask penetration Lateral broadening Resist hardening / residue Shadow-induced under-implantation

body.zh: 量测反馈：开放/阻挡区对比/CD与套刻/残留与缺陷
body.en: Metrology feedback: open / blocked regions, CD and overlay, residue and defects

body.zh: 片阻对比；片阻；阻挡区；开放区
body.en: Sheet-resistance comparison Sheet resistance Blocked region Open region

body.zh: SIMS剖面；浓度；深度
body.en: SIMS profile Concentration Depth

body.zh: CD与套刻测量
body.en: CD and overlay measurement

body.zh: 表面检查；•残留检查；• 缺陷评估
body.en: Surface inspection • Residue inspection • Defect assessment

body.zh: 关键参数如何影响结果
body.en: How key parameters affect results

body.zh: 工艺耦合与权衡
body.en: Process coupling and trade-offs

body.zh: 常见情况对比
body.en: Common cases compared
